words.enDefinition: hand-held mobile radiotelephone for use in an area divided into small sections, each with its own short-range transmitter/receiver

examples.en: Leave your cellphone in the locker before entering the pool area.
examples.zh: 进泳池区前，把「手机」存在储物柜里。

examples.en: Her old cellphone still works, though the screen has a crack.
examples.zh: 她那部旧「手机」还能用，只是屏幕裂了道缝。

words.enDefinition: to treat someone unfairly or make them suffer

examples.en: The law protects workers so employers cannot victimize those who report dangers.
examples.zh: 法律保护劳动者，雇主不得「迫害」上报安全隐患的员工。

examples.en: Referees promise that no player will be victimized for reporting abuse.
examples.zh: 裁判们承诺，任何举报侵扰行为的球员都不会被「刁难」。

words.enDefinition: not according to nature; not by natural means

examples.en: The pond is artificially stocked with trout every spring for the children.
examples.zh: 池塘每年春天都「人工投放」鳟鱼，供孩子们垂钓。

examples.en: The flowers looked artificially bright under the strong exhibition lights.
examples.zh: 展灯强光下，那些花的颜色显得「人工雕琢般」鲜艳。

words.enDefinition: in a steep manner

examples.en: The path rises steeply for the first mile, then flattens out.
examples.zh: 小路头一英里「陡峭地」爬升，之后就变平了。

examples.en: Ferry prices rose steeply after the harbour was privatised last year.
examples.zh: 去年港口私营化后，轮渡票价「急剧」上涨。

words.enDefinition: strike with disgust or revulsion

examples.en: The condition of the abandoned orphanage will appal any visitor.
examples.zh: 那座废弃孤儿院的惨状会让任何来访者「震惊」。

examples.en: The waste dumped beside the stream appalled the morning anglers.
examples.zh: 倒在小溪旁的垃圾让清晨的垂钓者「大为骇然」。

words.enDefinition: state characterized by emotions ranging from mild discontentment to deep grief

examples.en: There was quiet unhappiness in the village after the ferry line closed.
examples.zh: 轮渡航线停开后，村子里弥漫着一种无声的「不快」。

examples.en: Her letter home hid the unhappiness of the first winter abroad.
examples.zh: 她写给家里的信，藏起了出国头一个冬天的「苦闷」。

words.enDefinition: without expression; in a blank manner

examples.en: The new waiter stared blankly at our order in dialect.
examples.zh: 新来的侍者「茫然地」盯着我们用方言报的菜名。

examples.en: When asked about the missing oars, the boys just shrugged blankly.
examples.zh: 问起丢失的船桨，男孩们只是「一脸茫然地」耸耸肩。

words.enDefinition: subject to change or variation

examples.en: The old ladder felt unsteady against the wet barn wall.
examples.zh: 那架旧梯子靠在湿漉漉的谷仓墙上，「晃晃悠悠」的。

examples.en: Her unsteady first steps after the surgery delighted the whole ward.
examples.zh: 手术后她「踉跄的」头几步，让整个病房都高兴起来。

words.enDefinition: in an unwilling manner

examples.en: The cat left the warm windowsill unwillingly when the supper bowl rang.
examples.zh: 晚饭碗一响，猫才「不情愿地」离开温暖的窗台。

examples.en: He unwillingly admitted that the new ferry timetable suited nobody.
examples.zh: 他「勉强地」承认，新的轮渡时刻表谁都不合适。

words.enDefinition: in an impolite manner

examples.en: The tourist rudely pushed past the queue for the harbour ferry.
examples.zh: 那名游客「粗鲁地」插队挤上了港口轮渡。

examples.en: Stop rudely interrupting your grandmother when she tells the story properly.
examples.zh: 奶奶好好讲故事时，别「无礼地」打断她。

words.enDefinition: someone who takes part in an activity

examples.en: Each participant in the bread course takes home two loaves.
examples.zh: 面包课的每位「学员」都可以带两条面包回家。

examples.en: Every participant receives a printed map of the coastal walk.
examples.zh: 每位「参加者」都会拿到一张海岸步道的印刷地图。

words.enDefinition: a socket-shaped device for making an electrical connection; also a device for lifting a car

examples.en: The car jack slides neatly into the compartment beside the spare tyre.
examples.zh: 汽车「千斤顶」正好能收进备胎旁边的隔层。

examples.en: Plug the microphone into the audio jack on the back panel.
examples.zh: 把麦克风插进后面板上的音频「插孔」。

words.enDefinition: serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern

examples.en: Follow the numbered sequence of locks as you walk the canal towpath.
examples.zh: 沿运河纤道走时，按编号「顺序」经过各道船闸。

examples.en: The dance teacher teaches the steps in a simple sequence first.
examples.zh: 舞蹈老师先把舞步按简单的「先后顺序」教给大家。

words.enDefinition: game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop

examples.en: The new basketball hoop was installed beside the village school fence.
examples.zh: 新的「篮球」框装在了村校围栏旁。

examples.en: Evening basketball on the outdoor court keeps the teenagers out of trouble.
examples.zh: 傍晚在露天球场打「篮球」，让少年们远离是非。

words.enDefinition: the state of being male or female; a grammatical category

examples.en: The application form asks for name, age, and gender.
examples.zh: 申请表要求填写姓名、年龄和「性别」。

examples.en: The club welcomes members of any gender to its chess nights.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的象棋之夜欢迎任何「性别」的成员参加。

words.enDefinition: the act of speaking or acting for someone; a way of showing or depicting something

examples.en: Each village sends two representatives, so the council gives fair representation to all.
examples.zh: 每村出两名代表，这样议会就能给所有村庄「公平的代表性」。

examples.en: The painting is a striking representation of the storm over the bay.
examples.zh: 这幅画生动「再现」了海湾上空的风暴。

words.enDefinition: something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation

examples.en: The main variable in ferry times is the weather, not the schedule.
examples.zh: 轮渡时间最大的「变数」是天气，而不是班次表。

examples.en: Keep the oven temperature variable in mind when baking at altitude.
examples.zh: 在高海拔烘焙时，要记住烤箱温度是个「可变因素」。

words.enDefinition: distinguishing quality

examples.en: The village makes a clear distinction between market days and feast days.
examples.zh: 村里对赶集日和节庆日有明确的「区分」。

examples.en: She earned the distinction of being the first woman skipper on the route.
examples.zh: 她赢得「殊荣」，成为该航线首位女性船长。

words.enDefinition: outward features

examples.en: The external walls need repainting before the winter storms return.
examples.zh: 冬季风暴来临前，房屋「外部」墙面需要重新粉刷。

examples.en: Judge the house by its external condition only after checking the roof.
examples.zh: 查看屋顶之后，再从「外观」状况来评判这座房子。

words.enDefinition: (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence

examples.en: The lease contains a clause about keeping the yard tidy.
examples.zh: 租约里有一条规定保持院子整洁的「条款」。

examples.en: Our teacher explained that a clause needs both a subject and a verb.
examples.zh: 老师讲解说，「从句」必须同时具备主语和动词。

words.enDefinition: to tie or fasten something tightly; to constrain

examples.en: Bind the bean stalks to the canes with soft garden twine.
examples.zh: 用柔软的园艺细绳把豆藤「绑」到支柱上。

examples.en: The contract will bind both families to the harvest-sharing deal.
examples.zh: 这份合同将「约束」两家共同遵守收成分配的约定。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being significant

examples.en: The mayor explained the significance of the old bell to the visitors.
examples.zh: 市长向游客们讲解了那口老钟的「意义」。

examples.en: Nobody realised the significance of the empty bench by the war memorial.
examples.zh: 当时没人意识到战争纪念碑旁那张空长椅的「重要含义」。

words.enDefinition: the product of a quantity by an integer

examples.en: The storm tore multiple branches off the old chestnut tree.
examples.zh: 风暴把老栗树的「好几根」树枝都刮断了。

examples.en: She checked the ferry timetable multiple times before leaving home.
examples.zh: 出门前，她把轮渡时刻表「反复查了多遍」。

words.enDefinition: Mixed or mingled; surrounded by.

examples.en: The old letters were hidden amongst the hymn books at the chapel.
examples.zh: 旧信件就藏在礼拜堂的赞美诗堆「当中」。

examples.en: Amongst the market stalls, the honey stand is always the busiest.
examples.zh: 「在」集市各摊位「之中」，蜂蜜摊总是最热闹的。

words.enDefinition: the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something

examples.en: The old stone wall marks the boundary between the two farms.
examples.zh: 那堵老石墙标出两家农场的「分界」。

examples.en: Disputes over the field boundary ended once the surveyor marked it.
examples.zh: 测量员标定后，那块田的「边界」之争便告平息。

words.enDefinition: included or united as part of a whole

examples.en: The guidebook has incorporated maps at the back for the coastal walks.
examples.zh: 指南书末尾「附入的」地图，方便你走海岸步道。

examples.en: These incorporated suggestions made the final plan acceptable to both villages.
examples.zh: 这些「吸收采纳的」建议让最终方案为两村共同接受。

words.enDefinition: learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines

examples.en: The visiting scholar from the university studies old coastal dialects.
examples.zh: 大学来的访问「学者」研究古老的沿海方言。

examples.en: As a young scholar, he copied every inscription in the churchyard.
examples.zh: 年轻时做「学者」，他抄录了墓园里的每一处碑文。

words.enDefinition: government official who conducts criminal prosecutions on behalf of the state

examples.en: The prosecutor showed the court the receipts found in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 「检察官」向法庭出示了仓库里查获的收据。

examples.en: The young prosecutor questioned the harbourmaster for three hours straight.
examples.zh: 年轻的「公诉人」连续盘问了港务长三个小时。

words.enDefinition: statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn

examples.en: The plan rests on the premise that the ferry will run daily.
examples.zh: 这项计划的「前提」是轮渡每天都能开航。

examples.en: She questioned the premise of the report before reading the details.
examples.zh: 读完细节之前，她就先质疑了报告的「前提假设」。

words.enDefinition: to become aware of through the senses

examples.en: Dogs can perceive high sounds that our ears simply miss.
examples.zh: 狗能「感知」到我们耳朵听不见的高频声音。

examples.en: Villagers perceive the new road as progress, though some mourn the quiet.
examples.zh: 村民们「认为」新路是进步，尽管有人惋惜失去了宁静。

words.enDefinition: particular functioning condition or arrangement

examples.en: The bus runs in silent electric mode through the old quarter.
examples.zh: 公交以电力「模式」静音驶过老城区。

examples.en: Set the camera to night mode before shooting the harbour fireworks.
examples.zh: 拍港口焰火前，先把相机调到夜间「模式」。

words.enDefinition: decide upon or fix definitely

examples.en: The invitation does not specify whether children are welcome at the harvest meal.
examples.zh: 请柬没有「明确说明」丰收宴是否欢迎孩子。

examples.en: Please specify which dates suit you for the cottage booking.
examples.zh: 订小屋时，请「具体注明」哪些日期合适。

words.enDefinition: form or compose

examples.en: Twelve elected farmers constitute the drainage board for the valley.
examples.zh: 十二位民选农户「组成」山谷排水委员会。

examples.en: These old ledgers constitute the earliest record of the market prices.
examples.zh: 这些旧账簿「构成了」集市价格最早的记录。

words.enDefinition: component of production; something that goes into the production of output

examples.en: Before the vote, the council invited input from every household.
examples.zh: 投票前，市政邀请每个家庭提出「意见」。

examples.en: Add your input to the suggestion box by Friday, please.
examples.zh: 请在周五前把你的「想法」投进意见箱。

words.enDefinition: open, honest, and direct in speech

examples.en: To be frank, the soup at the inn tastes better than mine.
examples.zh: 「说实话」，客栈的汤比我做得好喝。

examples.en: She gave a frank answer about why the stall had closed.
examples.zh: 对于摊位歇业的原因，她给出了「坦率的」回答。

words.enDefinition: form a critical opinion of

examples.en: The committee will evaluate the market proposals again next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 委员会下周二将再次「评估」各项集市方案。

examples.en: Take a day to evaluate whether the cottage really suits you.
examples.zh: 花一天时间「评估」一下这处小屋是否真的合适。

words.enDefinition: put in effect

examples.en: What did the volunteers accomplish during the two-day beach cleanup?
examples.zh: 两天的海滩清理，志愿者们「完成」了哪些事？

examples.en: She managed to accomplish the whole ledger transcription before winter.
examples.zh: 入冬之前，她「完成了」整本账簿的誊录。

words.enDefinition: displaying numbers rather than scale positions

examples.en: The station clock is digital now, with big red numbers.
examples.zh: 车站的钟现在是「数字式」的，红色数字很大。

examples.en: Grandfather finally switched from film to a small digital camera.
examples.zh: 爷爷终于告别胶卷，换了一台小型「数码」相机。

words.enDefinition: physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning

examples.en: The doctor explained the sleep disorder to the worried night-shift worker.
examples.zh: 医生向忧心的夜班工人解释了这种睡眠「失调」。

examples.en: The kitchen was in complete disorder after the retirement party.
examples.zh: 退休欢送会过后，厨房里一片「杂乱」。

words.enDefinition: an abrupt movement

examples.en: The umpire calls the teams together for the toss at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，裁判召集两队进行「掷币」。

examples.en: Give the salad a quick toss before serving it to the guests.
examples.zh: 上桌前，把沙拉快速「翻拌」一下。

words.enDefinition: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer

examples.en: The fishermen pray for calm seas before the season opens.
examples.zh: 捕鱼季开始前，渔民们会「祈祷」海上风平浪静。

examples.en: Grandmother prays quietly in the chapel every evening at six.
examples.zh: 奶奶每晚六点都在小礼拜堂「默默祷告」。

words.enDefinition: the number of occurrences within a given time period

examples.en: The doctor checks the frequency of the baby's heartbeat at each visit.
examples.zh: 每次产检，医生都会查胎儿心跳的「频率」。

examples.en: The radio frequency changed after the new transmitter was installed.
examples.zh: 新发射塔装好后，电台「频率」改了。

words.enDefinition: the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)

examples.en: Check the exact dimension of the window before ordering the curtains.
examples.zh: 订窗帘之前，先量好窗户的准确「尺寸」。

examples.en: The garden adds a new dimension to the little cottage's charm.
examples.zh: 这座花园为小屋的魅力增添了新的「维度」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to or responsible for administration

examples.en: The village hall handles most administrative tasks for the parish council.
examples.zh: 村政厅承办教区议会的大部分「行政」事务。

examples.en: Filling in the administrative forms took longer than the ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 填这些「行政」表格，比坐轮渡过海还费时间。

words.enDefinition: tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times

examples.en: Farmers dry the corn in the yard before storing it.
examples.zh: 农民入库前会先在院子里晾晒「玉米」。

examples.en: Golden fields of corn wave above the lane in late August.
examples.zh: 八月末，「玉米」的金色田野在小路上方起伏。

words.enDefinition: failure to perform some promised act or obligation

examples.en: The company faces court action for a serious breach of the safety rules.
examples.zh: 该公司严重「违反」安全规定，将面临起诉。

examples.en: Repairing the breach in the sea wall took the whole winter.
examples.zh: 修补海堤的「缺口」花了整整一个冬天。

words.enDefinition: in a literal sense

examples.en: The recipe says to fold the dough literally, not stir it.
examples.zh: 菜谱说要「逐字照做」地翻折面团，而不是搅拌。

examples.en: The queue at the ferry office stretched literally around the block.
examples.zh: 轮渡售票处的队伍「实实在在地」绕过了整个街区。

words.enDefinition: the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)

examples.en: The sisters shared a long embrace on the station platform.
examples.zh: 姐妹俩在站台上久久地「拥抱」。

examples.en: He opened his arms in a warm embrace for the returning sailors.
examples.zh: 他张开双臂，给了归来的水手们一个温暖的「拥抱」。

words.enDefinition: an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)

examples.en: The children save their weekly allowance for the summer ferry trips.
examples.zh: 孩子们把每周的「零用钱」存起来，夏天好去坐轮渡。

examples.en: The company pays a travel allowance for deliveries beyond the bridge.
examples.zh: 对桥外的配送，公司支付交通「补贴」。

words.enDefinition: an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"

examples.en: The report examines the full scope of pollution in the estuary.
examples.zh: 报告全面考察了河口的污染「范围」。

examples.en: Repainting the hall is beyond the scope of our small budget.
examples.zh: 重新粉刷礼堂超出了我们这点预算的「范围」。

words.enDefinition: informal word for a dollar; a male deer

examples.en: The old trick is to pass the buck instead of fixing the fence.
examples.zh: 老套路就是把责任「推来推去」，而不是把栅栏修好。

examples.en: He flipped a buck to decide who would climb the mast.
examples.zh: 他抛起一枚「美元」，决定谁去爬桅杆。

words.enDefinition: one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line

examples.en: The teacher asked us to summarise the first paragraph in one line.
examples.zh: 老师要我们把第一「段」用一句话概括。

examples.en: Skip to the last paragraph for the ferry timetable changes.
examples.zh: 轮渡时刻表的改动，直接看最后一段「段落」就行。

words.enDefinition: discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of

examples.en: The smoke alarm detects even a whisper of burning toast.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器连烤焦面包的一丝烟味都能「探测到」。

examples.en: The vet quickly detected an infection in the old dog's paw.
examples.zh: 兽医很快「发现」老狗的爪子有感染。

words.enDefinition: permission to do something

examples.en: The landlord signed his consent for the loft conversion last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚房东签字「同意」了阁楼改造。

examples.en: Photographers need written consent before publishing pictures of the children.
examples.zh: 摄影师发布孩子照片前，需要取得书面「许可」。

words.enDefinition: be composed of

examples.en: The new harbour committee will comprise seven elected villagers and two officers.
examples.zh: 新的港务委员会将「由」七位民选村民和两名职员「组成」。

examples.en: The festival programme will comprise concerts, a market, and boat races.
examples.zh: 节庆活动将「包括」音乐会、集市和赛船。

words.enDefinition: person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it

examples.en: The local historian traced the bridge's builders through parish records.
examples.zh: 本地「历史学家」借助教区档案查出了大桥的建造者。

examples.en: As village historian, she keeps every carnival photograph since 1950.
examples.zh: 作为村里的「史料记录者」，她保存着 1950 年以来所有的狂欢节照片。

words.enDefinition: position 19 in a countable series of things

examples.en: She finished nineteenth in her very first long-distance swim.
examples.zh: 她第一次参加长距离游泳就拿到了「第十九名」。

examples.en: The lighthouse keeper's cottage dates from the nineteenth century or earlier.
examples.zh: 灯塔看守人的小屋建于「十九世纪」或更早。

words.enDefinition: country person

examples.en: The museum shows how a peasant family lived through the hard winters.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了「农民」一家如何熬过严冬。

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a peasant farmer on the terraced hills.
examples.zh: 他的祖父曾在梯田山坡上当「农民」种地。

words.zhGloss: 公用事业；公用事业公司
words.enDefinition: company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
acceptedZhAnswers: 公用事业；公用事业公司

examples.en: The power utility restored the lines to the outlying farms within a day.
examples.zh: 电力「公司」一天之内就恢复了偏远农场的供电。

examples.en: Residents complained to the water utility about the rusty supply pipes.
examples.zh: 居民就生锈的供水管道向水务「公司」投诉。

words.enDefinition: small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done

examples.en: The old wheelwright's workshop still smells of oak and iron.
examples.zh: 老车轮匠的「工坊」里仍弥漫着橡木和铁的气味。

examples.en: Dad turned the garage into a small workshop for mending bicycles.
examples.zh: 爸爸把车库改成了修自行车的小「工场」。

words.enDefinition: (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality

examples.en: There are two distinct accents on either side of the bay.
examples.zh: 海湾两岸的口音「截然不同」。

examples.en: The recipe needs a distinct chilli flavour, not a mild one.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱要「明显的」辣椒味，不能太淡。

words.enDefinition: in the order given

examples.en: The silver and bronze medals went to Anna and Pietro respectively.
examples.zh: 银牌和铜牌「分别」归属于安娜和彼得罗。

examples.en: The baker and the butcher open at seven and eight respectively.
examples.zh: 面包房和肉铺「分别」在七点和八点开门。

words.enDefinition: utter or declare in a very loud voice

examples.en: Don't yell across the yard; the fence carries sound to the neighbours.
examples.zh: 别隔着院子「大喊」，声音会顺着围栏传到邻居家。

examples.en: You could hear the coach yell instructions from the far goal line.
examples.zh: 从球门那头都能听到教练「吼」着指令。

words.enDefinition: true or available everywhere; applying to everyone

examples.en: The longing for home is a universal feeling among sailors.
examples.zh: 思乡之情是水手们「普遍」共有的感受。

examples.en: They designed a universal spanner that fits almost every nut on the boat.
examples.zh: 他们设计了一种「通用的」扳手，几乎能拧船上所有螺母。

words.enDefinition: comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy

examples.en: The neighbours filed a lawsuit over the fallen tree on the shared wall.
examples.zh: 因倒在共用墙上的那棵树，邻居们提起了「诉讼」。

examples.en: The lawsuit against the ferry company lasted nearly three years.
examples.zh: 针对轮渡公司的「官司」打了将近三年。

words.enDefinition: the act of storing something

examples.en: The loft provides storage for the carnival decorations and old flags.
examples.zh: 阁楼用来「存放」狂欢节装饰和旧旗帜。

examples.en: The harbour office rents dry storage space for fishing nets.
examples.zh: 港务处出租干燥的「仓储」空间，供渔网存放。

words.enDefinition: a complete list of items, often with descriptions

examples.en: The seed catalogue arrives every January, full of tempting pictures.
examples.zh: 种子「目录」每年一月寄到，图片引人垂涎。

examples.en: She ordered the peach trees from the nursery's autumn catalogue.
examples.zh: 她从苗圃的秋季「目录」上订购了桃树。

words.enDefinition: the art and style of designing buildings

examples.en: The town is famous for the red-brick architecture of its market hall.
examples.zh: 这座城镇以集市的红砖「建筑风格」闻名。

examples.en: She studies architecture and sketches the harbour warehouses every weekend.
examples.zh: 她学「建筑」，每个周末都去画港口仓库的速写。

words.enDefinition: be greater in scope or size than some standard

examples.en: Let the dough rise until it exceeds the rim of the tin.
examples.zh: 让面团发到「超出」模具边缘为止。

examples.en: The fine will exceed a thousand dollars if the noise continues.
examples.zh: 若噪音持续，罚款将「超过」一千美元。

words.enDefinition: positive motivational influence

examples.en: The free ferry pass is an incentive for villagers to shop locally.
examples.zh: 免费轮渡通行证是鼓励村民本地消费的一种「激励」。

examples.en: Offering the best parking spot gave the staff a real incentive.
examples.zh: 把最好的停车位当奖励，给了员工实实在在的「动力」。

words.enDefinition: person who is owned by someone

examples.en: The old sugar mill museum remembers the slaves who built its walls.
examples.zh: 老糖厂博物馆铭记着修筑厂墙的「奴隶」们。

examples.en: Generations of slaves were bought and sold in that harbour square.
examples.zh: 那座港口广场上曾世代买卖「奴隶」。

words.enDefinition: concerned primarily with theories or hypotheses rather than practical considerations

examples.en: The plan looks brilliant in theoretical terms but struggles in practice.
examples.zh: 这个方案「理论上」漂亮，实践起来却困难重重。

examples.en: Our instructor covers the theoretical side in the mornings and practice after lunch.
examples.zh: 教员上午讲「理论」，午饭后进行实操。

words.enDefinition: group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status

examples.en: The village team beat the elite riders from the national circuit.
examples.zh: 村队击败了全国巡回赛的「精英」骑手们。

examples.en: Only the elite of the fishing fleet dare cross in February.
examples.zh: 只有渔船队中的「尖子」才敢在二月出海。

words.enDefinition: the sacred writings of the Christian religions

examples.en: The family bible records every birth since the farm began.
examples.zh: 家族的《圣经》记载着农场开创以来的每一次添丁。

examples.en: She keeps her grandmother's bible on the shelf beside the hymn book.
examples.zh: 她把祖母的《圣经》和赞美诗集并排放在一起。

words.enDefinition: time available for ease and relaxation

examples.en: The harbour promenade fills with leisure walkers after Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 周日午餐后，海滨步道上满是「悠闲」散步的人。

examples.en: Retirement gave him leisure to finish the boat he began decades ago.
examples.zh: 退休让他有「闲暇」完成几十年前动手造的那条船。

words.enDefinition: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events

examples.en: In the worst-case scenario, the storm delays the ferry by a full day.
examples.zh: 最坏的「情形」是，风暴让轮渡整整延误一天。

examples.en: The council rehearsed an evacuation scenario for the coastal flood season.
examples.zh: 市政为沿海汛期演练了一套疏散「预案」。

words.enDefinition: the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface

examples.en: The full moon's reflection doubled the beauty of the still bay.
examples.zh: 平静海湾里满月的「倒影」让夜色加倍动人。

examples.en: She caught her reflection in the polished brass of the ship's bell.
examples.zh: 她在擦得锃亮的船钟铜面上看到了自己的「映像」。

words.enDefinition: magnifier of images of distant objects

examples.en: Grandfather watches the ferry traffic through an old brass telescope.
examples.zh: 爷爷用一架老铜「望远镜」观看轮渡的往来。

examples.en: The observatory opens its big telescope to visitors on clear Fridays.
examples.zh: 晴朗的周五，天文台向访客开放那台大型「望远镜」。

words.enDefinition: literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact

examples.en: She reads historical fiction about fishing villages all winter long.
examples.zh: 整个冬天她都在读以渔村为背景的历史「小说」。

examples.en: The distinction between fact and fiction blurs in most sea stories.
examples.zh: 大多数海员故事里，事实与「虚构」的界限都很模糊。

words.enDefinition: the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)

examples.en: In a lifetime of fishing, he had never seen the bay freeze.
examples.zh: 打了一「辈子」鱼，他从未见海湾封冻。

examples.en: The old engine has a lifetime guarantee, according to the dealer.
examples.zh: 据经销商说，这台老发动机有「终身」保修。

words.enDefinition: in the second place

examples.en: First we check the moorings; secondly, we test the radio.
examples.zh: 先检查缆绳；「其次」测试电台。

examples.en: Secondly, the council must approve the plan before any digging begins.
examples.zh: 「第二」，动土之前市政必须批准方案。

words.enDefinition: give testimony in a court of law

examples.en: The ferry captain agreed to testify about the night of the collision.
examples.zh: 轮渡船长同意就相撞当晚出庭「作证」。

examples.en: Two neighbours testified that the dog had never bitten anyone before.
examples.zh: 两位邻居「作证」说，那条狗此前从未咬过人。

words.enDefinition: used or designed for residence or limited to residences

examples.en: The old cannery is being turned into quiet residential apartments.
examples.zh: 旧罐头厂正被改造成安静的「住宅」公寓。

examples.en: New residents complain that the street is too busy for a residential zone.
examples.zh: 新住户抱怨，这条街车流太大，不像「住宅区」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of business done; the rate at which stock or staff is replaced

examples.en: The bakery's turnover doubled after the ferry route reopened in spring.
examples.zh: 春天轮渡航线重开后，面包房的「营业额」翻了一番。

examples.en: High staff turnover hurts the small hotel every single summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，员工「流动率」过高都让这家小旅馆头疼。

words.enDefinition: a small cut or notch in something

examples.en: Careful, there's a nick in the blade from last year's oyster knife.
examples.zh: 小心，刀刃上有个去年开生蚝留下的「小缺口」。

examples.en: He polished the nick out of the propeller before the regatta.
examples.zh: 帆船赛前，他把螺旋桨上的「刻痕」打磨掉了。

words.enDefinition: in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"

examples.en: The engine is reliable; furthermore, it uses far less fuel.
examples.zh: 这台发动机很可靠；「而且」，油耗也低得多。

examples.en: The cottage has no parking; furthermore, the stairs are steep.
examples.zh: 小屋没有停车位；「此外」楼梯还很陡。

words.enDefinition: distinctly dissimilar or unlike

examples.en: The market draws a diverse crowd of farmers, tourists, and students.
examples.zh: 集市吸引了农民、游客和学生等「形形色色的」人群。

examples.en: The island offers a diverse mix of woodland, dunes, and rocky shore.
examples.zh: 这座岛把林地、沙丘与岩岸「多样地」融为一炉。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed passageway; rooms usually open onto it

examples.en: The hospital corridor smells of floor polish and fresh lilies.
examples.zh: 医院的「走廊」里飘着地板蜡和新鲜百合的气味。

examples.en: A long corridor connects the harbour master's office to the customs shed.
examples.zh: 一条长长的「走廊」连接着港务长办公室和海关棚屋。

words.enDefinition: make stronger

examples.en: The builders reinforced the sea wall with fresh concrete blocks.
examples.zh: 建筑工人用新的混凝土块「加固」了海堤。

examples.en: A hot supper will reinforce you after a day of moving crates.
examples.zh: 搬了一天货箱后，一顿热腾腾的晚饭能让你「恢复元气」。

words.enDefinition: lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)

examples.en: The magistrate fined the captain and suspended his licence for a month.
examples.zh: 「地方法官」对船长处以罚款，并吊销执照一个月。

examples.en: Minor offences in the parish are heard by the local magistrate.
examples.zh: 教区内的轻罪案件由本地「治安官」审理。

words.enDefinition: without much difficulty

examples.en: Information about the tide tables is readily available at the harbour office.
examples.zh: 在港务处「随时可以」轻松拿到潮汐表。

examples.en: She readily agreed to water the greenhouse while we were away.
examples.zh: 我们外出期间，她「爽快地」答应照看温室。

words.enDefinition: to describe the distinctive nature of; to be typical of

examples.en: Tall chimneys and tight lanes characterize the older quarter of the town.
examples.zh: 高高的烟囱和狭窄的巷道是老城区的「特征」。

examples.en: Locals characterize the harbour master as strict but always fair.
examples.zh: 当地人形容港务长「严格却一贯公正」。

words.enDefinition: gesture involving the shoulders

examples.en: When I asked about the missing oars, he gave a simple shrug.
examples.zh: 问起丢失的船桨，他只是「耸了耸肩」。

examples.en: She answered every hard question with a smile and a shrug.
examples.zh: 每逢刁钻问题，她都以微笑加「耸肩」回应。

words.enDefinition: used or intended to defend; protecting against attack

examples.en: The troops dug a defensive line along the ridge before dawn.
examples.zh: 天亮前，部队在山脊沿线挖出了「防御」阵地。

examples.en: He grew defensive whenever anyone mentioned the missing ledger.
examples.zh: 谁一提那本丢失的账簿，他就变得「戒备起来」。

words.enDefinition: someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)

examples.en: The architect drew the village hall with a wide porch for rainy days.
examples.zh: 「建筑师」把村政厅设计成带宽门廊的样式，方便雨天使用。

examples.en: Our neighbour is the architect who restored the lighthouse keeper's cottage.
examples.zh: 我们邻居就是修复灯塔看守人小屋的那位「建筑师」。

words.enDefinition: any large and important church

examples.en: The cathedral bells can be heard across the whole harbour town.
examples.zh: 「大教堂」的钟声传遍整座海港小镇。

examples.en: Tourists photograph the twin spires of the cathedral from the ferry.
examples.zh: 游客们从轮渡上拍摄「大教堂」的双塔尖。

words.enDefinition: without being affected by something; in spite of the circumstances

examples.en: The market goes ahead regardless of the early morning frost.
examples.zh: 无论清晨霜冻与否，集市都照常开张。

examples.en: She walks the coastal path daily regardless of the weather.
examples.zh: 无论天气如何，她每天都走一遍海滨步道。

words.enDefinition: by that means or because of that

examples.en: The council drained the marsh, thereby ending the summer mosquito problem.
examples.zh: 市政排干了沼泽，「从而」解决了夏日蚊虫问题。

examples.en: He fixed the pump himself, thereby saving the village a repair bill.
examples.zh: 他自己修好了水泵，「就这样」为村里省下了一笔修理费。

words.enDefinition: distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers

examples.en: A family of deer crossed the lane just before the school bus.
examples.zh: 校车开过前，一小群「鹿」横穿了小路。

examples.en: Early risers often spot deer grazing near the orchard fence.
examples.zh: 早起的人常能看到「鹿」在果园栅栏边吃草。

words.enDefinition: the speech act of objecting

examples.en: Nobody raised an objection when the market moved to the square.
examples.zh: 集市迁到广场时，没有人提出「异议」。

examples.en: The lawyer's objection stopped the question before the witness answered.
examples.zh: 律师的「反对」让证人免于回答那个问题。

words.enDefinition: sweet yellow liquid produced by bees

examples.en: The stall sells comb honey from hives above the lavender field.
examples.zh: 摊位上卖的是薰衣草田上方蜂巢产的「蜂蜜」。

examples.en: Grandmother sweetens the cough remedy with a spoon of local honey.
examples.zh: 奶奶在止咳糖浆里加一勺本地「蜂蜜」调味。

words.enDefinition: very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk

examples.en: The infant slept through the whole christening in her grandmother's arms.
examples.zh: 「婴儿」在外婆怀里睡完了整个洗礼仪式。

examples.en: The clinic weighs each infant and plots the numbers on a chart.
examples.zh: 诊所给每个「婴儿」称重，并把数据记到图表上。

words.enDefinition: a room in a hospital with beds for patients

examples.en: The children's ward was decorated with paper boats for the storm season.
examples.zh: 汛期到来前，儿科「病房」挂满了纸船装饰。

examples.en: Grandfather moved from the emergency ward to a room with a window.
examples.zh: 爷爷从急诊「病区」转进了带窗的病房。

words.enDefinition: person who cares for persons or property

examples.en: Her aunt became her legal guardian after both parents were lost at sea.
examples.zh: 父母双双海上罹难后，姨妈成了她的法定「监护人」。

examples.en: The old sheepdog acts as guardian of the henhouse every night.
examples.zh: 那只老牧羊犬每晚都当鸡舍的「守护者」。

words.enDefinition: accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment

examples.en: Villagers seek the old postman's wisdom before buying their first boat.
examples.zh: 买第一条船之前，村民们都要来讨教老邮差的「智慧」。

examples.en: There's hard-earned wisdom in Grandmother's rule about never sailing on a red sky.
examples.zh: 奶奶那条「晚霞不出海」的规矩，是来之不易的生活「智慧」。

words.enDefinition: the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong

examples.en: Patience is a virtue that the tide teaches every young fisherman.
examples.zh: 「耐心」是潮汐教给每个年轻渔夫的美德。

examples.en: She praised the virtue of repairing things instead of replacing them.
examples.zh: 她称赞了修旧利废而非一扔了之的「美德」。

words.enDefinition: widely known person

examples.en: The retired jockey is the biggest celebrity in our little town.
examples.zh: 那位退役赛马骑师是我们小镇最大的「名人」。

examples.en: A television celebrity opened the new lifeboat station last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，一位电视「名流」为新的救生艇站揭幕。

words.enDefinition: a man-made waterway for boats or irrigation

examples.en: Barges still carry hay along the canal between the two towns.
examples.zh: 驳船仍沿「运河」在两镇之间运送干草。

examples.en: The canal was dug in 1848 to move coal to the harbour.
examples.zh: 这条「运河」开凿于 1848 年，用来把煤运往港口。

words.enDefinition: currently happening

examples.en: The search for the missing dinghy is ongoing, with boats out at first light.
examples.zh: 对失踪小艇的搜寻仍在「进行中」，天一亮各船就出发了。

examples.en: The bridge repair is an ongoing project that will last until autumn.
examples.zh: 大桥维修是一项将「持续」到秋天的「进行中」工程。

words.enDefinition: beam made of wood

examples.en: The builder stacks seasoned timber under the lean-to until spring.
examples.zh: 建筑工人把风干的「木料」码在披屋下，等开春再用。

examples.en: Old ships' timbers wash up on the beach after every big storm.
examples.zh: 每场大风过后，海滩上都会冲来旧船的「木材」。

words.enDefinition: domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age

examples.en: The farmer moves his cattle to the upper pasture in June.
examples.zh: 六月，农场主把「牛群」赶到高处的牧场。

examples.en: Cattle grid crossings save the sheep from wandering onto the main road.
examples.zh: 牛栏格栅拦住了羊群，免得它们游荡上大路。

words.enDefinition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

examples.en: It was evident from the long queue that the ferry had been cancelled.
examples.zh: 从长长的队伍就能「明显看出」，轮渡取消了。

examples.en: Her talent for knots was evident even in the scouts.
examples.zh: 还在童子军时，她打绳结的才能就已「显露无遗」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or befitting athletics or athletes

examples.en: The athletic field behind the school hosts the summer sports days.
examples.zh: 学校后面的「运动场」承办夏季运动会。

examples.en: Their athletic daughter swims the harbour crossing twice every summer.
examples.zh: 他们「擅长运动的」女儿每年夏天都横渡海港两次。

words.enDefinition: expert skill or knowledge in a particular field

examples.en: The boatbuilder's expertise saved the old sloop from the scrapyard.
examples.zh: 造船师傅的「专业造诣」让那条老单桅船免于报废。

examples.en: We needed someone with electrical expertise to rewire the village hall.
examples.zh: 重新给村政厅布线，需要懂电的「专业人才」。

words.enDefinition: a limit or restriction on what you can do

examples.en: The main constraint on the new marina is the height of the bridge.
examples.zh: 新游艇码头的主要「制约因素」是大桥的高度。

examples.en: Budget constraints forced the council to postpone the harbour mural.
examples.zh: 预算「限制」迫使市政推迟了港口壁画的计划。

words.enDefinition: the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers

examples.en: The fortune teller read the lines on my palm for a coin.
examples.zh: 算命师收了一枚硬币，替我看「手掌」上的纹路。

examples.en: She cooled the feverish child with a damp cloth on each palm.
examples.zh: 她用湿布敷在孩子每只「手掌」上，为高热降温。

words.enDefinition: serve oneself to, or consume regularly

examples.en: The old ferry consumes nearly twice the fuel of the new one.
examples.zh: 旧轮渡的燃料「消耗」几乎是新船的两倍。

examples.en: The family of six can consume a whole batch of pies in minutes.
examples.zh: 一家六口几分钟能「吃掉」整整一炉馅饼。

words.enDefinition: having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value

examples.en: The wealthy shipowner restored the row of cottages by the quay.
examples.zh: 那位富有的船主把码头边的一排村舍修葺一新。

examples.en: The town grew wealthy on herring, then quieter when the shoals moved.
examples.zh: 小镇靠鲱鱼「致富」，鱼群游走后便归于安静。

words.enDefinition: one of the huge systems of stars that make up the universe

examples.en: On clear nights, the galaxy arches over the dark harbour water.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，「银河」横跨黑沉沉的海港上空。

examples.en: The observatory volunteer pointed out our own galaxy, the Milky Way.
examples.zh: 天文台志愿者指给我们看我们所在的「星系」——银河。

words.enDefinition: special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all

examples.en: Meeting the queen was a privilege the old coastguard never forgot.
examples.zh: 见到女王是那位老海岸警卫员毕生难忘的「殊荣」。

examples.en: Club membership is a privilege that comes with mooring duties.
examples.zh: 俱乐部会员是一项「特权」，也意味着要承担系泊值班。

words.enDefinition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given

examples.en: The storm broke the slipway; consequently, the lifeboat launched from the sand.
examples.zh: 风暴毁坏了滑道，「因此」救生艇只能从沙滩下水。

examples.en: He skipped the lifejacket check and consequently missed the early crossing.
examples.zh: 他没做救生衣检查，「结果」错过了早班轮渡。

words.enDefinition: friend who is frequently in the company of another

examples.en: Her sheepdog is her constant companion on the long coastal rounds.
examples.zh: 那只牧羊犬是她漫长海岸巡线上形影不离的「伙伴」。

examples.en: He found a congenial companion in the man who shared his ferry seat.
examples.zh: 他在轮渡上的邻座找到了一位投缘的「同伴」。
